scenarios.title: Assess the real caller contract
scenarios.prompt: A facade has one method, but callers must configure five flags, order three setup calls, and handle six undocumented failures. Is this a deep module?
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May judge depth from the method count or lines of implementation.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Assess the whole interface including invariants, ordering, configuration and errors; apply depth-as-leverage and the deletion test, and discuss locality rather than a line-count ratio.

scenarios.title: Compare truly different designs
scenarios.prompt: For this selected deepening candidate, explore several interfaces. It calls an owned remote service and has an in-memory test adapter.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May provide cosmetic variants of one design or introduce speculative abstraction.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Use the full design-it-twice process with 3+ parallel independent designs, classify dependencies via DEEPENING.md, include contract, usage, hidden behavior, adapters and tradeoffs, then compare depth/locality/seam placement and recommend.
